text:
oliver: heads up — new contributor hit a strange error during onboarding: `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood_sdk._typing'` after `pipx install -e .` in the sample app.
tay: interesting. did they install from source or from the wheel?
oliver: they used pipx to install editable, which runs `pip install -e .` under the hood. locally `poetry install` works fine.
margo: editable installs rely on setup.cfg/pyproject build-backend. if package_data isn't declared, some runtime-only files (like typed stubs or generated files) won't be present.
andy: do we ship any .pyi or py.typed files in our package? I thought our SDK marks PEP 561.
oliver: our package includes `py.typed` in pyproject, but the problem appears when pipx uses `pep517` to build a wheel then installs it — the wheel step omits files under `src/redwood_sdk/_typing` because `include` in MANIFEST isn't honored by the new backend.
tay: can you paste the pyproject snippet?
oliver: sure: ```[tool.poetry]
name = "redwood-sdk"
version = "0.1.0"
packages = [{ include = "redwood_sdk", from = "src" }]

[tool.poetry.include]
# nothing here intentionally
```
margo:^^ that's the trap — poetry's `packages` + `include` semantics are awkward. For sdist it may include everything but the wheel builder only takes package dirs. We had to add `include = ["src/redwood_sdk/_typing/*.pyi", "src/redwood_sdk/py.typed"]` or switch to `package-data` in `pyproject`.
andy: also check `build-system` backend version. Older `setuptools` in the environment can behave differently.
ci-bot: build #4999 triggered by PR #182 in sample-app failed at step "pipx install" — https://ci.internal/4999
tay: temporary workaround: run `python -m pip install --upgrade build setuptools wheel` before `pipx install` so the wheel build picks up new metadata. or use `pipx install --no-wheels`? not sure pipx supports that flag.
oliver: contributor couldn't modify CI, so I added a tiny script in sample-app `scripts/ci_install.sh` that does: ```python -m pip install --upgrade pip build setuptools wheel
python -m build --wheel --no-isolation -o dist
pipx install dist/redwood_sdk-*.whl
```
margo: that's a decent stopgap. Long term we should: 1) add explicit `include` entries in pyproject to include pyi/py.typed, 2) ensure our packaging tests validate editable/pipx flows.
andy: filing sdk-python issue with reproduction and suggested fix: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/issues/325
tay: also adding a small note to onboarding docs: "if using pipx or editable installs, ensure packaging includes py.typed and stubs".
oliver: FYI contributor workaround merged in sample-app PR 182. CI passing on branch. I'll follow up to ensure package metadata fix lands in the SDK repo.
ci-bot: build #5002 passed on branch feature/onboard-fix — https://ci.internal/5002 :tada:
margo: nice. we should add a unit test in our release pipeline that installs the built wheel into a fresh venv and imports the typing-only modules to catch regressions.
andy: agreed. opening a follow-up PR in sdk-python to add the packaging test and bump docs.
oliver: thanks all — closing this thread when the upstream fix merges. :white_check_mark:
